title: Implement Dynamic NFT Attributes via Oracle Integration ('Living Artifacts')
description: The HoloCanvas platform aims to distinguish itself by creating generative art that feels alive. This task introduces the 'Living Artifacts' feature, where an NFT's metadata can evolve based on real-world, external data streams. This initial implementation will focus on linking an artifact's trait to the lunar cycle, fetched via an oracle. The task requires a deep understanding of the system's microservice architecture, from data ingestion at the oracle bridge to state changes in the core ledger and final representation in the gallery gateway. This is a multi-session task requiring careful, incremental development.

project_spec.name: HoloCanvas: A Micro-Gallery Blockchain for Generative Artifacts
project_spec.description:
HoloCanvas is an expert-level, C-based blockchain NFT platform that treats every deployed microservice as an artist’s “tool head” in a distributed, on-chain atelier. Rather than simply recording ownership, the system enables live, collaborative generation of audiovisual NFTs whose state evolves in response to on-chain events (bids, governance votes, off-chain sensor feeds, oracles, etc.). Each artifact is minted by a Factory-Pattern service that composes modular shader, audio, and metadata fragments submitted by creators, then immutably stores the creative recipe on a Layer-2 rollup chain. A State-Machine–driven consensus layer tracks each artifact’s life cycle—Draft, Curated, Auction, Fractionalized, Staked—letting collectors influence its future through DAO-style governance and DeFi staking pools.

The platform is carved into fine-grained microservices—Cryptograph, LedgerCore, Mint-Factory, Gallery-Gateway, DeFi-Garden, Oracle-Bridge, Wallet-Proxy, and Governance-Hall—communicating through an Event-Driven mesh (Kafka + gRPC). Observer-Pattern “Muse” services listen for artistic triggers (e.g., a threshold of likes or an external weather oracle) and may automatically evolve an NFT’s media layers via Strategy-Pattern plug-ins. Proxy-Pattern wallet adapters hide chain complexity from end-users, while a pluggable Consensus Engine lets curators swap between PoS-Staking and Delegated-Artistry strategies to experiment with alternative creative economies.
dependencies: gRPC / Protocol Buffers (service contracts, language-agnostic serialization)
OpenSSL + libsodium (cryptographic primitives, wallet key management)
libsecp256k1 (ECDSA signatures for transactions and smart contracts)
ZeroMQ (lightweight intra-cluster messaging for low-latency consensus)
PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB (transaction and state persistence, historical analytics)
Redis (ephemeral state cache for fast NFT metadata assembly)
IPFS C bindings / libp2p (decentralized media storage)
Docker + Kubernetes (containerization and orchestration of microservices)
Prometheus + Grafana (observability and on-chain health dashboards)
